BiblicalUsage: Mahlon was the son of Elimelech and Naomi, named in Ruth 1:2 when the family came into the country of Moab, and Ruth 1:5 says Mahlon and Chilion died there, leaving Naomi a widow. Ruth 4:10 names him again when Boaz buys all that was Mahlon's and takes Ruth, the wife of Mahlon, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Mahlon's short life is the hinge of the whole book: his death empties Naomi's house, and his name is the one Boaz raises back up.
RelatedPeople: Mahlon, Son of Elimelech; Ruth; Naomi
